title: Derelict freighter
text: A dead freighter drifts in the dark. You strip its holds before the cold takes your hands.

title: Uncharted world
text: Your scanners find a world no chart shows. The survey data sells well to the cartographers.

title: Forgotten navigation beacon
text: An old beacon still broadcasts its star charts. Three nearby stars are now on your map.

title: Hidden fuel cache
text: A smuggler's cache holds sealed fuel cells. Your tank is full.

title: Alien artefact
text: Something older than any known species sits in the rock. You haul it aboard.
